Halloween
Fest – Friday

When
Friday, 9 October
6 p.m.
About

Friday, October 9: Doors at 6 p.m. with a DJ and tarot readings until sundown. Films begin after dark: 'Young Frankenstein' followed by a 15-minute intermission and then 'The Lost Boys'. Organizers advise dressing warmly and bringing blankets. This is the season closer for Penn Treaty Pictures' outdoor screening series.

Organisers and Promoters
Wooder Ice
Where
Penn Treaty Park
1301 N. Beach Street
